extraction_notes: SI Tables S4-S6 report carbon utilization ratio, CH3OH yield (mmol/g), and CO yield (mmol/g) for CZC-OA/CuZnCe under ICCU variable conditions; these are not represented by dedicated fields in the requested schema and were not entered as methanol STY or selectivity to avoid deriving or mislabeling quantities. SI Figure S7 contains printed stacked-bar yields for additional CuZnCe preparation variants and plotted conversion/selectivity points, but exact reaction conditions are not stated in the SI and the plotted conversion/selectivity values are not read precisely; it was not used for structured records. SI Table S8 is a literature-comparison table; only the this-work row was used to identify the condition corresponding to the duplicated CZC-OA Table S1 result, while literature rows were excluded. Characterization figures/tables and DFT tables were excluded.
